install_startup.recipe_modification_note: The project's own compose file pulls from docker.flagsmith.com, a vendor-run registry mirror that this sandbox's egress policy denies (403). flagsmith/flagsmith is the same image also officially published to Docker Hub - pointed the compose file at flagsmith/flagsmith:latest there instead, with a standalone Postgres service and a migrate-db one-shot job (Flagsmith's own documented self-hosted pattern), reached via the org's already-allowed Docker Hub route.
